potential_global_variable.meaning: Candidate readings of the frozen language, not newly approved universal inclusion/exclusion rules. Both require actual visibility evidence; neither says all caps always qualify or always fail.

F03.mapping_scope: Only the three explicitly disputed upper caps and two named parent motifs. This does NOT supply a complete interpretation-conditioned mapping of all side/red remainder.

cross_entry_constraints.no_shared_physical_entity_claim: The six fixed entries are distinct drawn entities. Shared manuscript/image provenance is a dependence but does not make their motifs the same physical variable.
cross_entry_constraints.coupling_reason: F03 explicitly retains an endpoint-boundary reading with an operational-convention component. The package cannot honestly recast every such choice as independent pixel noise. Uniform whole-six conditioning has not been established.
cross_entry_constraints.required_before_true_scoring: Root must either define and audit a complete outer-case mapping that preserves this constraint within the frozen scientific scope, or report numerical execution/operability incomplete. Observer does not approve scores or a new rule.

result.algorithm: Enumerate Ashmole F01/F03/F05 joint entry signatures; conditionally optimize Morgan F04/F06 full entry signatures independently. F02 has zero contrast weight but stays in all15 pairs.
result.arithmetic: Exact integer numerators over32; rational output reduced. No per-coordinate domain relaxation.
limitations: Conditional frozen-name branch only; strict branch undefined.
Exact over supplied joint signature sets, not necessarily biologically realizable or statistically sharp.
Input domains must already preserve within-entry candidate dependencies; unsupported cross-entry constraints are not inferred.
Pair extrema are marginal and must not be combined as one global assignment.
Numerical agreement is not independent image/name evidence.
